title: General Posting Setup park or source route decision
purpose: Decide whether to park the Page 314 INLAND/WAREN/4400/5400 matrix row until a better supported UI/source route exists, or choose one materially new, source-backed route without writing values in the decision case.

smartDecision.whyNow: Four Page 314-related runs have not produced a trusted saved INLAND/WAREN/4400/5400 row. Repeating the same UI writes would be slower and riskier than an explicit park/source decision.

sourceBackedBy.title: Microsoft Learn - Understand the general ledger and Chart of Accounts / General Posting Setup page
sourceBackedBy.use: General Posting Setup lines combine business and product posting groups; each line can also be opened in its own posting setup card.

sourceBackedBy.title: Microsoft Learn - Posting group setup
sourceBackedBy.use: General Posting Setups combine business and product posting groups and choose G/L accounts.

smartDecision.risk: Proceeding to master data or posting claims while Page 314 remains unresolved would make the Foundation look more complete than it is.
smartDecision.fallback: Park General Posting Setup as unresolved, keep INLAND/WAREN groups as proven prerequisites, and continue only with a consciously bounded next setup dependency.
